title: Studio Data › Actions: switching what an action does (or its Type) leaves an invalid draft that blocks every later save of the object with no message; Body Shape is a free-text box that writes an invalid value
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

After a kind switch every subsequent object autosave is refused 422 and the UI shows nothing; a reload reverts the action. Typing the documented `{wrap}` form into Body Shape also bricks saves.

## Reproduction

1. What it does → "Run a script" → saves `body: {language}` without `source` → 422 `actions.N.body.source`.
2. Type a body, then Type → API → `body` is kept → 422 "`body` only runs for `type: 'script'`"; all following endpoint/method edits are refused; reload reverts to "Update fields" (three attempts on `call_api`).
3. Body Shape: type `{"wrap":"payload"}` → 422 `actions.N.bodyShape` invalid_union, later saves fail until reload; a stored `{wrap:"payload"}` displays as "payload" and would re-save as an invalid string.

## Expected

A kind/type switch drops keys the new kind does not accept and holds incomplete required keys; a refused save is shown at the action; Body Shape is a Flat / Wrap(key) control.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` kind/type switch and the bodyShape control.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the data gap-fill card.
- Business reason: The editor silently stops saving the whole object; builders lose subsequent work.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `switching action type in Studio leaves invalid draft body only runs for type script, bodyShape text input invalid_union` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 5 hits, all closed (#6938 bodyShape renderer forwarding, #4352 runtime gate; none about the Studio switch).
- QA id: G4
